data.name: Australian Hunter
data.detailed_description:
About the Game

Oh my God! Someone save the poor Australians! Kangaroos, camels, rabbits, wild boars are overpopulating! A large number of invasive species are plaguing Australia, causing immense damage to the natural environment. You will become a super cool hunter to rescue the Australian people from their plight!

Game Features

  • Magnificent and realistic Australian natural landscapes and a vibrant ecosystem.

  • A rich variety of wild animals, including kangaroos, camels, wild boars, goats, wild horses, and rabbits, etc..

  • Tame and feed various wild animals as pets, and ride camels and wild horses.

  • Drive cars and motorcycles across the vast Australian landscape and enjoy the beautiful scenery.

  • You can craft or purchase various weapons, including firearms, bows, and melee weapons.

  • Build various structures, such as campfires, campsites, and shelters, Building houses.

  • Hunt animals to sell meat and fur, become a wilderness bounty hunter, earn Australian government rewards, and purchase more advanced equipment, weapons, and vehicles.

  • Develop agriculture and grow vegetables.

  • Fishing allows you to catch various fish to sell and cook.

  • Supports single-player and multiplayer modes, allowing you to team up with friends for hunting and survival.

  • A realistic day-night cycle and dynamic weather system.

data.short_description: Australia is facing a wildlife overpopulation crisis. You will play as a hunter, surviving, hunting, and working in the Australian wilderness to help the Australian people solve this ecological disaster.
